title: Unattended-Safety Hard Walls in the Stop-Gate
summary: Add machine-enforced hard walls to scripts/handoff so an unattended run cannot burn the token budget: (1) a wall-clock limit per atomic task that refuses further writes and execs, (2) a readonly band and a permanent lockdown triggered by the context percentage, (3) an allow-list for commands executed through `gate -- exec`, and (4) the matching machine-checkable clauses in .clinerules.
